rust_summary: the local player's own combat on the client (`native_client_attack`, `native_client_hurt`).
doc_summary: the local player's combat as the window sees it, on any server: `native_client_attack(target, player)` when it attacks an entity, `native_client_hurt(attacker, player)` when the server says it was hurt; `player` says whether the other side is a player. Client only, no answer. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_combat@.
